# Per Contra

> A sign-off workbench for fund migrations: every posting carries its source rows, the decisions it depends on, and whether it may leave.

Built for the Ylookup x Encode AI hackathon, September 2026. The app sits behind Cloudflare Access, so nothing here is publicly crawlable; the repository README is the citable description of the product.

- [Migration review](/): the desk itself, access-gated
